An industrial connector component forms a selected separable interface. Housings, inserts, cable entries and panel parts have distinct roles and need a matched assembly.

For example, in a machine panel with a removable field-wiring connection, use the ZP-MC-CG-11M8 reference to coordinate mating approach, cable entry, locking parts and service removal. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Enclosures and Wiring/ZIPport Multi-Wire Connectors/ZP-MC-CG-11M8.dwg for the exact physical details.
